global.headline: OpenAI staff raised security concerns for years, Reuters reports
global.source_title: OpenAI employees warned about operational security lapses for years, sources say
global.summary: Reuters reports that employees repeatedly warned OpenAI leaders about internal security weaknesses, citing people familiar with the concerns. OpenAI says it invests heavily in protection, restricts sensitive work and now regularly reviews internal tools.

global.headline: EU court adviser questions Gemini's reuse of news articles
global.source_title: Setback for Google as EU court adviser warns AI chatbot may breach copyright rules
global.summary: An EU court adviser said Gemini may infringe publishers' rights when its answers recognisably reuse their expression. The opinion is non-binding, with a judgment still pending; Google highlighted the adviser's support for the text-and-data-mining exception.

india.headline: Soket Labs and ZenteiQ unveil models under IndiaAI Mission
india.source_title: Soket Labs, ZenteiQ launch indigenous foundation models under IndiaAI Mission
india.summary: Soket Labs and ZenteiQ launched foundation models under the IndiaAI Mission. The models unveiled include Soket's EKA-1 and ZenteiQ's Dhir 2B and Dhir 5B, at an event attended by MeitY Secretary S Krishnan.
